About this data
Data in these tables show monthly, quarterly and annual price indices for a range of fuels purchased by UK domestic consumers.
Data in these tables are a re-publication of data within the Office of National Statistics' Consumer Prices Index (CPI) series.
Data is available in current (cash) and real terms in 2025 prices. Real terms data has been deflated using the GDP deflator.
Indices are available back to 1990 (both in real and current terms).
Price data for coal (up to January 2022), smokeless fuel and heating oil since 2005 is also available.
Table 2.1.1 shows quarterly figures for this series (data is available back to January - March 1990).
Table 2.1.1a shows quarterly figures for gas and electricity excluding VAT.
Table 2.1.2 shows annual figures for this series (data is available back to 1990).
Table 2.1.3 shows monthly figures for this series (data is available back to January 1990).
Table 2.1.3a shows monthly average prices for coal, smokeless fuels and heating oils.

2.1.3 Consumer prices index (2025=100): fuel components, monthly, United Kingdom
Figures include VAT at 5% where applicable.
Real price series are deflated using GDP (market prices) deflator. GDP updated is updated when published by ONS.
Data may change regularly due to rebasing. The ONS use the latest full year of data as the base year and the Department rebases to match this as soon as it is feasible to do so.
Real price indices will be updated once that quarter's GDP deflator is available and are therefore less timely than the current price indices.
Freeze panes are turned on. To turn off freeze panes select the 'View' ribbon then 'Freeze Panes' then 'Unfreeze Panes' or use [Alt,W,F].
